question: In which of the following decades was there a negative growth rate of population in India?
solution:
The correct answer is "**1911 - 1921**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the most recent census, India's population has grown, yet between 1911 and 1921, it actually **decreased**.
 
• Before **1921**, both male and female children had poor life expectancy rates at birth.
